To show the song that is playing, Terminal needs to read notifications.

1. Tap “Open notification access”.
2. In the list, tap Terminal.
3. Turn on “Allow notification access” and confirm.
4. Come back here.

To show the song that is playing, Terminal needs notification dots on app icons to be on.

1. Tap “Open notifications”.
2. Scroll to the end of the Notifications list.
3. Turn on the highlighted option, the notification dot on app icon.
4. Come back here.

If no option is highlighted, search for “notification dot” in the Notifications settings.
